summary: Verified React Native/Expo ScriptM8 startup fix. Metro bundler bundles App.tsx cleanly for both iOS and Android (HTTP 200, ~4.8MB). registerRootComponent(App) is present at App.tsx:1002 with import at line 5. Bundles contain 14 total registerRootComponent/AppRegistry.registerComponent matches each (8 registerRootComponent + 6 AppRegistry.registerComponent) — well above the pre-fix baseline of 3. Zero references to expo-notifications / getExpoPushTokenAsync / Notifications.* across /app/frontend. app.json has updates.enabled=false. eas.json contains no 'channel' entries in any build profile. App.tsx 'APP STARTED' console.log confirmed present in the compiled bundle.
context_for_next_testing_agent: React Native/Expo bundle inspection test. Metro dev server at http://localhost:3000 serves /App.bundle?platform=ios|android. Verify (1) HTTP 200, (2) grep bundle for registerRootComponent + AppRegistry.registerComponent >= 10 combined, (3) grep /app/frontend for expo-notifications refs = 0, (4) app.json updates.enabled=false, (5) eas.json has no 'channel' keys. Supervisor service name is 'expo'.
rca_of_the_issue: package.json declared 'main': 'App.tsx' which bypassed Expo's default AppEntry.js that normally calls registerRootComponent. App.tsx itself never invoked registerRootComponent, so React Native's AppRegistry never received the root component and threw the 'main has not been registered' invariant. Fix: added import { registerRootComponent } from 'expo' at line 5 and registerRootComponent(App); as final statement at line 1002. Verified bundle now includes the registration path.
